ننخرق (form VII)
# نَنْخَرِقُ (nanḵariqu) /nan.xa.ri.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْخَرَقَ (inḵaraqa)
# نَنْخَرِقَ (nanḵariqa) /nan.xa.ri.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَرَقَ (inḵaraqa)
# نَنْخَرِقْ (nanḵariq) /nan.xa.riq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْخَرَقَ (inḵaraqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
